title: Proc-rat-ination
html:
Quest Giver: Kurley the Lazy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Bring Kurley somes of yours Fizz Rock for a giant penny. He's in A Secret Squeakeasy.

Quest Reward: 1 King's Coin

Return to: Kurley the Lazy

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Bring Kurley somes of yours Fizz Rock for a giant penny. He's in A Secret Squeakeasy.

Offer:

Heys yous, rats-face! I needs helps, squeak, and you look-a-like you's not doing anythings. I wasis supposeds to bes mining Fizz Rocks for Sissirats' and I gots thirsty. I thoughts I just stop by Squeakseasy, squeak, and gets some FizzWater to gets some energy.

Was bads idea because one led to four and now I is heres all tired and having no energies. And I still hasn't mades my quota. Sissirats is goings to kick the squeaks out of me. Can you helps?

I just needs some Fizz Rocks to make mys quotas. If you brings 20 Fizz Rocks to mes I will give yous this really bigs shiny penny I founded on the floor. Townstons Guards are carelessess with theirs giant pennies! Sound like a deals? Great!

Turn-in:

Squeaks! Thankses! You saveds my tail, yous did!

Hmms, with my quotas met, I can stays and get anothers FizzStar! Maybe Dungeon Runner will gets me some mores Fizz Rock? Then I don'ts has to leave!

Objectives:

  • Mined Fizz Rock ×20

Client level range: 3–20
